name: Roundtuit
pitch: For the things you'll do when you get a round tuit.
lead: A to-do and honey-do list for the things you'll do when you get a round tuit. Keep your own list, let the people you live with ask you for things, and finally see what got done.
features: The people in your life can ask you for things from their own phone. Their requests land on your list with their name on them.
Shared lists that stay in step
Make a list with your household for groceries, chores or a project. Everyone adds and ticks things off, and a change shows on everyone's phone within a second or two.
Repeats that work like a calendar
Every Saturday, or every month on the 15th. A repeating task puts a fresh copy on your list each time it comes due.
Give a task a due date and pick when it reminds you. Tick it off and the reminder clears, on every phone that had it.
Everything about a task, if you want it
Category, who asked, due date, notes, cost and time spent. Switch off the fields you don't use, and each category can show its own.
Metrics shows how many tasks you finished, what they cost, how long they took and how often you were on time, for any list, person or stretch of time.
plans: The whole list on your phone, with no ads and no account.
A backup to your own Google Drive every day, and whenever you ask.
Your list on every device, plus making shared lists and inviting people to ask you for things.
data: On Free your list lives on your phone. Daily Backup saves a copy to your own Google Drive, where Roundtuit can see only the files it made.
Sync keeps your list on Roundtuit's server so your devices all match and shared lists work. When Sync ends, your list moves back to your phone.
